name: webpic
description: TypeScript/WebGPU plasma-physics data visualizer + lightweight analyzer

scripts.gen:export: uv run --project ../pypic pypic export bundle --inline-single-use-defs --include-x-extensions -o src/schema/pypic-export.generated.json
scripts.gen:emit: node scripts/codegen/emit.ts && biome format --write src/schema src/compute
scripts.gen: npm run gen:export && npm run gen:emit
scripts.gen:check: npm run gen:emit && git diff --exit-code -- src/schema src/compute
